releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.24 — the app now tells you why it stopped instead of just closing. If a launch fails, the next start shows the exact error with a Copy button, so it can be sent in one tap. The image loader is also isolated: a photo that cannot be fetched can no longer take the whole app down. Everything from 1.0.23 is included — compressed photos with thumbnails, an instant chat list, private media, and no in-app server option.
